title: TFLN ring resonator, thermo-optic self-heating (FDFD + heat)
description:
The FDFD TFLN ring of em/tfln_ring_resonator_fdfd.json plus heat: em_heat_joule turns the power the lossy ring absorbs into heat, which leaves through the buried oxide, and heat_em_thermo_optic red-shifts the ring with its temperature.
Study: a coupled frequency_domain scan, blue to red (ascending wavelengths), each wavelength a relaxed FDFD + heat fixed point continued from the previous one, swept over P_in = 1 W/m (cold reference) and 4000 W/m. At 4000 W/m the ring stays hot while the scan drags its resonance along: the dip becomes the thermal triangle and drops back to the cold branch past its red end.
Set lambda_cold to the cold through-port dip first (tfln_ring_thermo_optic.py prints it; or run em/tfln_ring_resonator_fdfd.json): the scan covers lambda_cold - 3 nm .. lambda_cold + 12 nm.
Sweep tab: Result em.through_port, series fraction_positive = the two through-port spectra; 'Derived value vs wavelength' dT_ring / A_ring = ring temperature rise and absorbed fraction per power. Log: one line per wavelength with its iteration count.

parameters.name: lambda0
parameters.description: wavelength of a stationary solve (switch the study to Stationary); the frequency_domain study scans lambda_scan_start..lambda_scan_stop instead

parameters.name: P_in
parameters.description: input power of the bus mode in W per m of z (2D); the ring heats in proportion. The study sweeps it over 1 and 4000 W/m

parameters.name: lambda_cold
parameters.description: cold resonance (through-port dip at P_in -> 0): placeholder, set it to the dip tfln_ring_thermo_optic.py prints (step 1) or the dip of em/tfln_ring_resonator_fdfd.json

parameters.name: lambda_scan_start
parameters.description: first scanned wavelength, ~2 cold linewidths blue of the resonance

parameters.name: lambda_scan_stop
parameters.description: last scanned wavelength; raise it when the hot dip still runs at the scan end (higher P_in)

parameters.name: P_relax
parameters.description: power scale of the coupling relaxation in W/m: w_relax = 1/(1 + P_in/P_relax)

parameters.name: w_relax
parameters.description: study relaxation of the thermo-optic loop-back: ~1 (plain Picard) when cold, 0.2 at 4000 W/m, where the plain fixed point oscillates on the hot branch (loop gain g < -1; the relaxed loop converges while |g| < 2/w - 1)

parameters.name: w_wg
parameters.description: bus and ring waveguide width

parameters.name: r_ring
parameters.description: ring radius (centre line)

parameters.name: gap
parameters.description: bus-to-ring edge-to-edge gap

parameters.name: margin
parameters.description: cladding between the structure and the PML

parameters.name: Lx
parameters.description: domain width; the bus runs along x

parameters.name: y_bus
parameters.description: bus centre line

parameters.name: y_ring
parameters.description: ring centre y

parameters.name: Ly
parameters.description: domain height

parameters.name: x_source
parameters.description: mode source line; launches the bus mode toward +x only

parameters.name: x_input
parameters.description: input port, between the source and the ring; fraction_negative = power reflected by the ring

parameters.name: x_through
parameters.description: through port; fraction_positive = through-port transmission

parameters.name: port_half_span
parameters.description: half length of the port lines across the bus; the mode is < 1% of its peak at their metal ends

parameters.name: n_eff
parameters.description: effective index of the bus mode at lambda0 (only for sigma_ring; the ports solve their own mode)

parameters.name: core_fraction
parameters.description: fraction of the mode power inside the core

parameters.name: round_trip_loss
parameters.description: artificial power loss fraction per ring round trip (near critical coupling); the absorbed power heats the ring

parameters.name: sigma_ring
parameters.description: ring conductivity in S/m giving round_trip_loss

parameters.name: T_ambient
parameters.description: substrate and reference temperature in K

parameters.name: t_film
parameters.description: thickness of the LN film the 2D model stands for: the substrate sink acts on this thickness, and P_in * t_film is roughly the device power in W

parameters.name: t_box
parameters.description: buried oxide between the film and the silicon substrate

parameters.name: h_substrate
parameters.description: heat transfer coefficient in W/(m^2 K) to the substrate through the buried oxide (k of silica / t_box)
